verdict.rationale: cubic's memory-and-learning docs say you can reply to its comments explaining what it should do differently and it remembers for next time. Thumbs up/down reactions also calibrate what counts as useful versus noise, and direct feedback on its comments is named as a learning source. That covers pushing back and having the reviewer learn. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that rejected feedback actually stops recurring, and documentation of how learned memories are scoped, viewed or edited.
